# IAIS Eddy Current Array Inspection

Informational site for IAIS India and IAIS UAE ECA enquiries. Application feasibility, equipment and standards are reviewed per project; listed industry uses do not assert IAIS project history.

## Discovery notes
- Canonical site: https://eddycurrentarray.com/
- Content format: static HTML pages with page-level metadata, JSON-LD, Open Graph and Twitter cards.
- Main topics: Eddy Current Array inspection, surface inspection, tube inspection, applications, quality approach and contact details.
